arabic text: JAWAAN KI HAI MAYYAT YUN DILSE LAGAALE ABHI,\nYEH KON AARAHA HAI YUN THOKARE KHAAKE ABHI
english translation text: HOLD THE DEAD BODY OF THE YOUTH AGAINST YOUR HEART, WHO IS THAT COMING WHILE STUMBLING?

arabic text: JAWANI ME MARNE KI HASRAT HAI KISKI\nZAIFI ME KAANDHON PE MAYYAT HAI KISKI
english translation text: WHOSE WISH IS IT TO DIE DURING THEIR YOUTH?\nWHOSE DEAD BODY IS ON HIS SHOULDERS\nDURING OLD AGE?

arabic text: KHUDA DUSHMANO KO YEH GHAM NA DIKHAYE KABHI\nZAIFI ME YE GHAM KOI DIL NA PAAYE KABHI
english translation text: MAY ALLAH NOT GIVE THIS SADNESS EVEN TO THE ENEMIES, MAY NO HEART RECEIVE THIS SADNESS\nIN OLD AGE

arabic text: DUA MAA YEH KARTITI THI ZINDAAN RAHO TUM\nPHALO PHOOLO AABAD SHAD RAHO TUM
english translation text: HIS MOTHER WOULD PRAY, 'MAY YOU REMAIN ALIVE'\nMAY YOU REMAIN PROSPEROUS

arabic text: YAHAAN MAA DUA ME MUSALLA BICHAYE ABHI\nWAHA LAASH BETE KI KHAIME ME AAYE ABHI
english translation text: HERE, THE MOTHER SPREADS OUT HER PRAYER MAT FOR DU’A. THERE, HER SON'S BODY ARRIVES INTO THE TENT

arabic text: JO BETE KA DEKHA, PHATA HUWA SINA\nPUKAARI YE MAA BAS HUWA KHAK JINA
english translation text: WHEN SHE SAW HER SON'S OPEN CHEST\nTHE MOTHER CRIED, 'MY LIFE HAS COME TO AN END'

arabic text: JIYUNGI ME AB, KAISE YEH DAAGH UTHAYE ABHI\nKHUDA MUJHKO DUNYA SE JALD UTHAALE ABHI
english translation text: 'HOW CAN I LIVE WITH SUCH A GREAT SORROW?'\n'MAY ALLAH TAKE ME FROM THE WORLD RIGHT NOW'

arabic text: BAHAN KO YE MOLA KI AWAAZ AAYI\nANDHERA HAI AANKHO ME MAJBOOR BHAI
english translation text: THE SISTER HEARD HER BROTHER SAY\n'THERE IS DARKNESS IN MY EYES'

arabic text: YEH LAASHA UTHAAYE YA DIL KO SAMBHALE ABHI\nZARA BACHE BHEJO KE MAYYAT UTHAALE ABHI
english translation text: SHOULD I LIFT UP THIS DEAD BODY OR TAKE CARE OF MY HEART? SEND THE CHILDREN TO HELP ME CARRY THE DEAD BODY
